'''The Onyx Crest''' is an island located south-west of [[The Great Conch]], in the [[Unquiet Ocean]]. Docking at the island requires level 47 [[Sailing]]. It is a volcanic island, with the forming volcano still fully visible on the west side of the island.

Two [[Fishing spot (lantern)|fishing spots]] for [[lantern harpooning]] are found on the eastern shore. Multiple [[butterfly ray]] spawns are present near the [[mooring point]].

[[Small key (The Onyx Crest)]] can be dug up on the island, requiring a [[spade]]. It is used to obtain the [[gale catcher schematic]] from a chest on [[Anglers' Retreat]].

On the east side of the volcano, the [[Bird nest (Sea charting)|nest of a fearless bird]] can be charted.

A [[medallion fragment]] can be obtained by killing or pickpocketing the [[Pirate (Thieving)|pirates]] on the island.

==History==
The island is used as a hideout, both by escaped prisoners and by pirates of The Onyx Raiders faction, who operate in the [[Unquiet Ocean]].{{CiteNews|quote=They can be found in the south of the Unquiet Ocean, near the Onyx Crest, an island to which they often retreat. |url=Pirate Encounters Design & Rewards|title=Pirate Encounters Design & Rewards|newsdate=8 April 2026|notes=|name=}} The Onyx Raiders are a violent faction of pirates that target merchant ships, kill the entire crew, and leave the ship stripped of any valuables.{{CiteNews|quote=The Onyx Raiders are a bloody and violent pirate faction who inspire fear and accrue wealth through their vicious attacks on merchant vessels. Frequently they kill the entire crew of such ships and leave them stripped bare of any valuables.|url=Pirate Encounters Design & Rewards|title=Pirate Encounters Design & Rewards|newsdate=8 April 2026|notes=|name=}} Their name comes from a ritual their captains perform where they have one of their eyes replaced with an [[onyx]] gem that they plundered.{{CiteNews|quote=Their name comes from a savage ritual all captains must undergo to have one eye replaced with an Onyx gem they have plundered. |url=Pirate Encounters Design & Rewards|title=Pirate Encounters Design & Rewards|newsdate=8 April 2026|notes=|name=}}

== Trivia ==
* The pirates inhabiting the island could be escaped prisoners. On the north-west corner of the island, a wrecked rowboat can be found. A grave can be found next to the rowboat, with the examine text "A lone grave looking out over the sea." On the path from the rowboat to the pirate settlement, two sets of striped clothing resembling prison garb can be found.
